title: Answer: takes no position on space

statements.text: The theory takes no position on what space is. Lamme notes the IIT proposal that seen space rests on grid-like connectivity in visual cortex without adopting it.

sources.quote: it was recently proposed (in the context of IIT) that the perception of space, as it unfolds in front of our eyes, is supported by brain areas whose units are linked by a grid-like connectivity
